n_target.reason: no N of the grid [200] reaches 90% correct family-level selection; extend the grid (PLAN.md section 5: 100, 200, 400, 800) or fix identifiability before any real-data fit
n_target.rule: N_target is the smallest N of the grid at which the model selected by held-out NLL on the within-subject 20% selection fold belongs to the true generator's family in at least 90% of the (generator, seed) cells at that N; responses needed for calibration = N_target x items per subject (170 on the shared design). Null when no N of the grid reaches 90%.
